producer_findings.topic: No new callback or trackpad HID publication
producer_findings.finding: Enumeration is synchronous under the existing command gate; the poll timer is armed only after super::start succeeds. Pinned IOHIDDevice calls handleStart before asking for newReportDescriptor or publishing interfaces. newReportDescriptor still returns only the owned device1 keyboard descriptor. poll still delivers only m1kbd_keyboard_input-qualified device1 messages and counts/discards device2/other messages. No extra IOHIDDevice/IOHIDInterface, attach/registerService path, pointer publication or getReport/setReport implementation appears. Base report operations remain Unsupported. Failed T1 enumeration fails the whole experimental keyboard start; it does not masquerade as successful trackpad attachment.

All frozen keyboard HW/board/PIO/protocol inputs are byte-identical. Exact function comparison also finds startHardware, receive, poll, fail, quiesce, stopGated, handleStop, stop, disposeTransport, free, terminate and descriptor functions unchanged. Failures still stop transport, timer quiescence still precedes resource release, and unload/dynamic termination remain refused. T1 is GET-only at the additional protocol-command level, not a no-write hardware survey: the existing keyboard power/reset/GPIO/PIO initialization and SPI transmissions still occur, and failure can stop/power down that existing transport. No shared-parent reset or new PMGR/GPIO/PIO operation is introduced.
